turns.question: How many euros more did a social lead cost us than a search lead in September 2026?
turns.answer: In September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30), the cost per lead was 52.50 EUR for social and 42.07 EUR for search, so a social lead cost about 10.43 EUR more than a search lead (the difference of those two queried figures).
